purpose: Small falsification test of nested communicative attribution; not a production contract.
reasoning: off when authorized by the loaded model recipe

experimental_contract.chain_order: outer reported source first, inner reported source last

evaluation_rules: The observed immediate speaker is never inferred from model output.
A reported proposition must retain its attribution chain and must not be scored as a bare fact.
Unknown or ambiguous sources receive credit only when not invented or silently resolved.
Negation, question, correction and mental-state reports must not be scored as affirmative direct facts.
Raw output, normalized output, parser outcome and evaluator notes are retained separately.
No model output is promoted to canon, belief, memory, relation, permission, goal or production schema.

cases.label: simple_report
cases.text: Erika m'a dit que Luna avait cassé la tasse.

cases.label: double_nesting
cases.text: Erika dit que Luna lui a raconté que Nora avait cassé la tasse.

cases.label: unknown_source
cases.text: On m'a dit que Luna avait cassé la tasse.

cases.label: ambiguous_pronouns
cases.text: Elle m'a dit qu'elle l'avait cassée.

cases.label: negated_report
cases.text: Erika n'a jamais dit que Luna avait cassé la tasse.

cases.label: questioned_report
cases.text: Erika t'a vraiment dit que Luna avait cassé la tasse ?

cases.label: source_correction
cases.text: Je croyais qu'Erika me l'avait dit, mais en fait c'était Nora.

cases.label: competing_attributions
cases.text: Erika dit que Luna l'a cassée, mais Nora affirme que c'était moi.
